Here is an interesting problem:

When using LEDIT, the system recognizes that I have an Ann Arbor,
with a Meta key.

If I later create a COMPLR fork with ^K, it seems to lose that fact that I
have a Meta key when I return to my LEDIT fork.

Has anyone else experienced this before?

Can anyone suggest a fix?
